selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This remains the load-bearing method gap because it asks for a directly testable, task-local procedural object whose decision value is anchored to the complete artifact's downstream effect rather than to an artifact-generated proxy. Reframe as a solvable object closes it by turning effect-preserving procedural reduction into a nonempty, dependency-closed subset problem with deterministic source-grounded units, an exact SCC quotient, and a sealed paired-effect certificate.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under the shared_object thread, the same certified subset reads the complete artifact, no-skill branch, retained procedures, measured costs, contract, and guardrails, so effect preservation and net-benefit accounting remain one method rather than two modules. Reframe as a solvable object closes this gap by making cost-adjusted paired effect, contract validity, and guardrail noninferiority simultaneous feasibility conditions for that subset.

deliverable_coverage: method - both gaps use reframe_as_solvable_object, whose C00 instantiation yields a runnable deterministic atom compiler, exact dependency quotient, bounded subset worker, and sealed task-local effect-preservation certificate.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: the method conditions on an independently locked user task and makes no representativeness or population-transport claim.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: Out of scope: the certificate is task-local and is not a cross-paper predictor, ranking model, or calibration claim.
